topics.title: C++ Core Syntax, Namespaces & References
topics.objective: Understand standard streams, namespace qualification, and lvalue reference semantics.
topics.example: std::string name; std::cin >> name; const int& ref = val;
topics.exercise: Build a console calculator that performs arithmetic using pass-by-reference parameters.

topics.title: Classes, Constructors & RAII Lifetime Management
topics.objective: Master resource acquisition is initialization, destructors, and encapsulated state.
topics.example: class Buffer { public: explicit Buffer(size_t sz); ~Buffer(); private: char* data_; };
topics.exercise: Create a custom FileHandle wrapper class that guarantees file closure via RAII.

topics.title: Standard Template Library (STL Containers & Algorithms)
topics.objective: Utilize std::vector, std::unordered_map, iterators, and std::sort efficiently.
topics.exercise: Implement a student grade analyzer using std::vector and std::transform.

topics.title: Templates & Compile-Time Generic Programming
topics.objective: Design generic functions and class templates with type parameters.
topics.example: template <typename T> T find_max(const T& a, const T& b) { return a > b ? a : b; }
topics.exercise: Write a generic Stack<T> container class supporting push, pop, and top operations.

topics.title: Modern Smart Pointers & Move Semantics
topics.objective: Eliminate manual memory management using std::unique_ptr, std::shared_ptr, and std::move.
topics.example: auto ptr = std::make_unique<Widget>(); auto moved = std::move(ptr);
topics.exercise: Refactor a raw-pointer binary search tree into a memory-safe smart pointer implementation.
